column1: # The pinned failures of every known-failure row of scripts/checks-manifest.tsv (scripts/verify-run-manifest.py).
# A known failure verifies as KNOWN-FAIL only when it exits with `exit`, prints at least its min_pass PASS lines, and
# every failure line in its log is one of its `fail` rows (the label, or its start up to a separator), each of which
# still fails. Anything else, a new FAIL in the same file, a crash, a failed compile, is FAIL.
# Labels: "FAIL ..." / "FAIL: ..." lines, unittest "FAIL: test_name", "Precondition failed: ..." / "Fatal error: ...".
